channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: Ex-Google engineer convicted of stealing AI trade secrets to benefit China
item.description: A federal jury on Thursday convicted Linwei Ding, 38, of seven counts of economic espionage and seven counts of theft of trade secrets after an 11-day trial in the U.S. District Court in the Northern District of California.

item.title: Don Lemon's arrest escalates Trump's clashes with journalists
item.description: The former CNN anchor arrested Friday has never been afraid of controversy, despite some career setbacks.

item.title: Writers Guild of America's staff union authorizes strike, weeks before major negotiations
item.description: Three years after the major strike shut down Hollywood, the Writers Guild of America's staff union has authorized its own strike.

item.title: Catherine O'Hara in 10 unforgettable roles: Where to watch them
item.description: The Canadian actor was a versatile performer whose decades-long career took her from a comedy troupe to box office and television hits. Here are some of her best roles.

item.title: Austin Beutner's daughter found beside a highway in Palmdale the night she died
item.description: Sheriff’s deputies responded to assist paramedics, who treated Emily Beutner, 22, at the scene.

item.title: 'We want a change to happen.' L.A. County students walk out over ICE raids
item.description: Middle and high schoolers walked out of classrooms across L.A., Long Beach and Pasadena districts to protest the Trump administration's ICE crackdowns. UCLA, USC, Cal State and other college campuses also held protests.

item.title: 'National shutdown' brings protests to L.A., across the nation; demonstrators clash with police
item.description: Nationwide protests take place Friday as part of a "national shutdown" in response to immigration actions in Minnesota. Protestors clashed with police

item.title: Latest Epstein files include emails between Ghislaine Maxwell, LA28 Olympics head Casey Wasserman
item.description: The latest cache of investigative files on Jeffrey Epstein includes personal emails exchanged between Casey Wasserman, chairman of the LA28 Olympics organizing committee, and convicted sex offender Ghislaine Maxwell.
